_doc: Findings of scripts/audit-ungated-game-addresses.py that stand, each with the reason it is safe. Keyed by file, function and expression; count is how many times that expression occurs there. A finding with no row, a row whose site is gone, a row whose sinks no longer match and a row without a reason all fail the gate. A finding that a one-line is_supported_build() guard would clear gets the guard instead of a row.

sites.reason: The version-resource walk behind is_supported_build itself. directory_rva comes from the image's own resource directory (game_file_version -> resource_directory -> version_resource_data), which describes the running build on every build.
Same walk: an entry of the resource directory the image itself declares.

The for-hook helper: hands base + rva to a hook API that resolves it (MhHook::new, register_union_hook*, register_shared_hook*). Every game_rva_for_hook(..) call is a site of this audit and is held to reaching one.

table_rva is the exception directory's rva, read out of the running image's own optional header (read_u32(optional + entry), with the entry bounds-checked against the size the COFF header declares and the rva checked against the first section), so it describes the running build on every build. It is the .pdata the *_runtime_derived hook APIs audit against.

descriptor_rva is an element of the base-class array the live object's own class hierarchy descriptor points at, reached from a locator that locator() accepts only when its self-rva matches its address; RTTI rvas describe the running image on every build.

type_descriptor_rva is read by class_name out of the live object's RTTI complete-object locator, which locator() accepts only when the locator's own self-rva matches; RTTI rvas describe the running image on every build.

RE_IMAGE_BASE is the flat image base 0x140000000 the RE notes are written against, not the running module's base, and verified_va's one non-test caller (map_seams.rs, the call-refusal log line) prints it. The address that is called is verify_seam's base + seam.rva, which passes behind its resolve_detour_address let-else.
Game::at serves Game::f and the readers; lib.rs builds Game::new(base) only after game::check_sites(base) passed, and check_sites refuses any build but 2.7.2.0 before comparing a byte.

register is the product hub's er_effects_union_register_2720 export (er_hook::UnionRegisterFn), which calls register_union_hook -> resolve_target -> resolve_detour_address; the other arm is register_union_hook itself. Both refuse another build.
